frase_clave: To help ensure that workers are free to participate in safety and health activities, Section 11(c) of the OSH Act prohibits any person from firing or in any manner retaliating against any worker for exercising rights under the OSH Act.
texto_fiel: Ten presente, y que lo sepa tu equipo, que la ley prohíbe tomar represalias contra quien ejerce sus derechos de seguridad y salud
razon: El libro describe el derecho y la prohibición de represalias; no pide expresamente al empleador explicarlo, aunque sí pide enseñar a los jóvenes sus derechos (L1747). Concreta en la misma dirección sin datos nuevos.

frase_clave: Whenever a worker is exposed to contact with parts of fixed electric equipment or circuits that have been de-energized, the circuits energizing the parts are locked out or tagged, as appropriate.
razon: Parafrasea el bloqueo y etiquetado de circuitos desenergizados.

frase_clave: The NIOSH HHE Program helps employers and employees learn whether health hazards are present at their workplace ... Evaluations are done at no cost.
razon: Literal: HHE gratuita para saber si hay peligros.

frase_clave: Covers including skylight screens, are able to withstand, without failure, twice the maximum intended load that may be imposed on the cover at any one time.
dato: que las barandillas soporten el doble de la carga máxima
texto_fiel: Proteger cada abertura con cubierta, barandilla o equivalente; las cubiertas deben soportar el doble de la carga máxima prevista
razon: El libro exige el doble de la carga solo a las cubiertas (L1481); las barandillas aparecen como forma de proteger la abertura (L1477) sin requisito de carga. Buscado twice/load/guardrail en todo el libro: no se aplica a barandillas.

frase_clave: Key job safety information/instructions are routinely reinforced in a variety of ways, especially over the first several weeks on the job
texto_fiel: Reforzar de varias maneras las instrucciones clave de seguridad, sobre todo durante sus primeras semanas en el puesto
razon: El libro dice first several weeks, sin cifra. Buscado four weeks/4 weeks/month: no aparece. La cifra cuatro es inventada.

frase_clave: Ground-fault circuit interrupters are installed on each temporary 15 or 20 ampere, 120 volt alternating current (AC) circuit at locations where construction, demolition, modifications, alterations, etc. , are performed.
razon: Resume el requisito de GFCI en circuitos temporales; omite el detalle técnico pero no añade nada.

frase_clave: Organization such as the American National Standards Institute (ANSI) and National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) issue voluntary consensus standards ... These are not OSHA standards, but they are developed ... to reflect current expertise and industry best practices.
razon: Recoge los estándares de consenso voluntario como buenas prácticas, no como norma.

frase_clave: Floor holes are guarded by a cover, a guardrail, or equivalent on all sides (except at stairways or ladder entrances).
texto_fiel: Revisar que cada abertura de piso de la instalación esté protegida con cubierta, barandilla o equivalente
razon: La lista de autoinspección (L79-L83) implica revisar las aberturas; el paso concreta esa inspección sin datos nuevos.

frase_clave: If your workers are organized, set up communications, as you do in normal labor relations, to coordinate action on hazards in your business.
razon: Coordinar con sindicatos los temas de peligros: dicho por el libro.

frase_clave: worksite-specific procedures for: ... cleaning, disinfecting, storing, inspecting, repairing, discarding, and otherwise maintaining respirators. / Respirators are regularly inspected, cleaned, sanitized and maintained.
A designated, trained individual at the worksite is responsible for (1) assessing and monitoring conditions (e. g. , temperature and humidity) and workers for symptoms of heat-related illness
The Small Business Resource Guide provides plans, tools, tips, and information for keeping your workers safe and well
Only authorized and trained workers are permitted to use welding, cutting, and brazing equipment.
Managers and workers have been trained on relevant child labor laws.
razon: Formarse y formar a quien ayuda en las leyes de trabajo infantil.

frase_clave: Employers can also read OSHA's standard interpretations, which are letters or memos written in response to questions from the public
SHARP recognizes small business employers who have used consultation services and operate an exemplary safety and health program.
texto_fiel: Revisa si calificas para el programa SHARP, que reconoce a quienes usaron la consulta y tienen un programa de seguridad ejemplar
razon: El libro pone como criterio haber usado la consulta y tener un programa ejemplar; el paso lo concreta como haber aplicado las recomendaciones, en la misma dirección.

frase_clave: Respirators are National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH)- approved for the particular application.
Exit doors and doors in the required path to the exit are not locked, blocked, or otherwise obstructed.
A written respiratory protection program has been established and implemented in accordance with the requirements of 29 CFR 1910.134(c).
razon: Programa escrito y específico del lugar según 1910.134.

frase_clave: Standpipes, fire hoses, and fire hose valves, are inspected regularly and tested annually.
texto_fiel: Inspecciona con regularidad y prueba una vez al año las mangueras y válvulas contra incendio
razon: El libro fija la prueba anual pero la inspección solo como regular, sin frecuencia; el paso pone la inspección también anual. Buscado annually/regularly/month en todo el libro: no hay frecuencia anual para inspeccionar mangueras.

frase_clave: The plan addresses the types of actions expected of different workers for the various types of potential emergencies.
texto_fiel: Asegura que el plan diga qué acciones se esperan de cada trabajador según el tipo de emergencia, y que las conozcan
razon: El libro pide que el plan defina las acciones de cada trabajador; la capacitación en el plan no se dice en esa sección, aunque va en la misma dirección (L1763 jóvenes preparados para emergencias).

frase_clave: A worksite receives a deferral from OSHA or State Plan programmed inspections during the period that its SHARP designation is valid.
texto_fiel: Si obtienes la designación SHARP, tus inspecciones programadas quedan aplazadas mientras esa designación esté vigente
razon: El libro da otro valor para el mismo dato: aplazamiento (deferral) mientras la designación sea válida, no exención. Buscado exempt/defer: solo aparece deferral para SHARP.

frase_clave: All workers receive training on the workplace violence prevention program, (including de-escalation techniques), what to do in an emergency
Exit doors can be opened from the direction of exit travel without the use of a key, tool, or any special knowledge or effort when the building is occupied. / Exit doors are side-hinged and swing.
razon: Une dos puntos del libro sin añadir.

frase_clave: Through this program, authorized trainers provide 10- and 30-hour training programs.
razon: Recurso Outreach de 10 o 30 horas presentado por el libro.

frase_clave: An annual summary is prepared at the end of each calendar year using OSHA Form 300A ... is posted during the months of February, March, and April.
razon: Preparar y publicar el resumen anual; el periodo se remite a la norma del mercado sin cambiarlo.

frase_clave: Most OSHA Strategic Partnerships are based out of local OSHA Area or Regional Offices.
razon: Concreta lo que el libro dice sobre dónde se gestionan las asociaciones.

frase_clave: Employers are partially exempt from OSHA's injury and illness recordkeeping requirements if 1) they had 10 or fewer workers ... or 2) they are in certain low-hazard industries
razon: Averiguar la exención según tamaño y actividad.

frase_clave: Doors on cold storage rooms are provided with an inside release mechanism that releases the latch and open the door even if the door is padlocked or otherwise locked on the outside.
Grates or similar type covers over floor holes, such as floor drains, are designed to allow unimpeded foot traffic and rolling equipment.
Young workers understand that they will not be fired or disciplined for reporting an unsafe work condition, an injury or a "near-miss."
Sufficient access and working space is provided and maintained around all electrical equipment
The plan address procedures for assisting people during evacuations, particularly those with disabilities or who do not speak English.
razon: Localiza English como idioma local; sin añadir.

frase_clave: If you are in a state with an OSHA-approved State Plan, you may be subject to different or additional requirements
razon: Revisar si tu estado tiene Plan Estatal.

frase_clave: professional associations that have a broad range of expertise and information on workplace safety and health and have local chapters that small businesses could join.
Workers exposed to arc welding rays and other hazards created by welding, cutting, or brazing operations are protected with PPE and protective clothing.
razon: EPP y ropa protectora contra rayos de arco; la protección ocular contra radiación está en L1373.

frase_clave: Many workers' compensation carriers ... conduct periodic inspections and visits to evaluate safety and health hazards. ... Contact your carrier to see what it has to offer.
Small Business Development Center (SBDC) Program to provide management and technical assistance to current and prospective small business owners.
razon: Recurso del libro para asistencia técnica.

frase_clave: Injury and illness records (OSHA 300, 300A, and 301) are kept at the worksite for at least five years. / Worker medical and exposure records are retained for the time period required
razon: Conservar registros por el mínimo exigido; no cambia la cifra, la remite a la norma.

frase_clave: Panic hardware or fire exit hardware installed on a required exit door allows the door to open by applying a force of 15 pounds (6. 80 kilograms) or less
razon: Poca fuerza según el estándar local: no contradice las 15 libras, las remite al estándar.

frase_clave: Suitable fire extinguishing equipment is available for immediate use.
The plan identifies a clear chain of command and designates a person authorized to order an evacuation or shutdown of operations.
You must electronically submit information from your Form 300A Summary to OSHA annually ... if: You have an establishment with 250 or more workers ... or ... in certain industries
razon: Envío electrónico según tamaño y sector; remite los umbrales al mercado sin cambiarlos.

frase_clave: The OSHA Training Institute partners with OSHA Training Institute Education Centers ... to deliver courses on OSHA standards and occupational safety and health topics
Workers designated to wear tight-fitting respirators are fit-tested before their first use of a respirator and at least annually thereafter.
All OSHA publications are free at www. osha. gov/publications.
An acclimatization plan is in place to modify work duties for and to closely supervise (1) new workers, (2) temporary or contract workers, and (3) workers returning from extended leave
razon: Literal parafraseado; omite temporales sin añadir.

frase_clave: Read the introduction to the subpart heading
Emergency lighting, where provided, is tested for 30 seconds each month, and annually for 90 minutes.
Workers under 18 do not do any hazardous work or operate hazardous equipment prohibited by state and federal child labor laws.
To participate, employers must submit an application to OSHA and undergo a rigorous onsite evaluation by a team of safety and health professionals.
A written program is in place to prevent workplace violence. The program is reviewed annually and updated as necessary.
razon: Literal, con la misma frecuencia anual.

frase_clave: A trained and equipped attendant is positioned outside the confined space, whose sole responsibility is to watch the work in progress, sound an alarm if necessary, and render assistance.
dato: usar al vigilante para alcanzar herramientas y registrar lecturas
texto_fiel: Asignar al vigilante exterior como única tarea vigilar el trabajo, dar la alarma si hace falta y prestar asistencia
razon: El libro dice que la única responsabilidad del vigilante es vigilar, alarmar y asistir; cargarle otras tareas lo contradice. Buscado attendant en todo el libro (L1339-L1345): nada apoya darle tareas extra.

frase_clave: Workers who regularly work on or around energized electrical equipment or lines are instructed in cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR).
texto_fiel: Aprender RCP si tú o alguien de tu negocio trabaja con regularidad en o cerca de equipos o líneas con tensión
razon: El libro limita la RCP a quien trabaja con regularidad junto a equipos energizados; expuesto a la electricidad es más amplio, pero en la misma dirección y sin datos nuevos.

frase_clave: PIT operator performance is evaluated at least once every three years, and workers are retrained as necessary.
texto_fiel: Reevaluar el desempeño de cada operador de montacargas al menos cada tres años
razon: El libro fija al menos cada tres años; el paso cambia el plazo a cinco. Plazo cambiado.

frase_clave: For more information, and to find contact information for your State Plan, see OSHA's State Plans webpage.
Fire watchers are assigned when welding or cutting is performed in locations where a fire might develop.
razon: Literal en el contexto de soldadura del nodo.

frase_clave: If you have any questions in determining whether a standard applies to your workplace, visit the OSHA website or contact the nearest OSHA Area Office or your state On-Site Consultation program.
employers request a consultation visit from their local Consultation program and determine the scope of the visit.
Rest breaks are provided and their length and frequency are adjusted, as needed.
texto_fiel: Proveer agua potable, sombra y descansos, ajustando su duración y frecuencia según haga falta
razon: Agua, sombra y descansos están en el libro; frecuentes concreta la frecuencia que el libro deja a ajustar según necesidad, sin cifra.

frase_clave: Unauthorized workers are not permitted to ride on PITs.
to find contact information for your State Plan, see OSHA's State Plans webpage.
razon: Contactar al Plan Estatal: recurso del libro.

frase_clave: A buddy system is in place so workers observe each other for signs of heat-related illness.
Employers and safety and health professionals can sign-up for QuickTakes at www. osha. gov/quicktakes.
Have a penalty reduction policy for small businesses
texto_fiel: Ten en cuenta que, por esta ley, OSHA debe tener una política de reducción de multas para pequeños negocios
razon: El libro solo dice que OSHA debe tener esa política; preguntar por ella al recibir una citación la concreta en la misma dirección.

frase_clave: When possible, young workers participate in OSHA 10-hour trainings
razon: Localiza el curso OSHA 10 horas como capacitación formal cuando exista.

frase_clave: Produce Small Entity Compliance Guides for some agency rules
PITs are inspected at the beginning of each work shift for any safety concerns. / PITs in need of repair are removed from service immediately.
Involve small businesses in developing proposed rules expected to significantly affect a large number of small entities through Small Business Advocacy Review Panels.
texto_fiel: Si una regla propuesta afectará mucho a un gran número de pequeños negocios, OSHA debe escucharlos en paneles de revisión
razon: El libro pone como condición que la regla afecte de forma significativa a muchas pequeñas entidades; el paso lo reduce a que te afecte a ti. Misma dirección, sin cifra nueva.

frase_clave: Used drums, barrels, tanks and other containers are thoroughly cleaned of substances that could explode, ignite, or produce toxic vapors, before hot work begins.
The plan outlines specific evacuation routes and exits ... The plan identifies one or more assembly areas
healthcare and social assistance, correctional settings, late-night retail, or taxi and for hire services/public transportation.
razon: Ejemplos tomados del libro; omite centros penitenciarios sin añadir.

frase_clave: Loads handled do not exceed the rated capacity of the PIT.
a method for accounting for all workers. / The plan addresses how visitors will be assisted in evacuation and accounted for.
Recognizing the signs and symptoms of heat-related injuries and illnesses. ... Administering first aid and CPR for heat-related illness.
Electrical work performed by workers or contractors complies with OSHA standards.
Outreach training does not fulfill the training requirements found in OSHA standards. Employers must provide additional training for their workers on specific hazards of their job.
Through the Alliance Program, OSHA works with organizations such as trade and professional associations, labor unions, educational institutions
texto_fiel: Explora el Programa de Alianzas de OSHA, en el que OSHA colabora con asociaciones comerciales, profesionales y sindicatos
razon: La Alianza es entre OSHA y esas organizaciones, no entre tu negocio y ellas; el paso va en la dirección del programa pero confunde las partes.

frase_clave: Routes (means of egress) to exits, when not immediately apparent, are marked with visible exit signs. / All exits are marked with exit signs that are illuminated
texto_fiel: Marcar todas las salidas con letreros de EXIT iluminados y señalizar las rutas hacia ellas cuando no sean evidentes
razon: El libro pide letrero iluminado en cada salida y señal visible en las rutas cuando no son evidentes; el paso lo simplifica como iluminado en todas las rutas.

frase_clave: recognize employers ... who have implemented effective safety and health management systems and maintain injury and illness rates below national Bureau of Labor Statistics averages
razon: Revisar los criterios de VPP del libro.

frase_clave: Testing and maintenance of automatic sprinkler systems is performed by a qualified worker or sprinkler contractor.
A worksite analysis has identified workplace violence-related hazards.
Be responsive to small business inquiries about complying with the Agency's regulations
texto_fiel: Usa los canales de consulta de OSHA para resolver tus dudas sobre cómo cumplir sus normas
razon: El libro dice que OSHA debe responder las consultas de pequeños negocios; antes de que te citen es un encuadre añadido sin dato concreto.

frase_clave: Protection from retaliation means that an employer cannot retaliate by taking "adverse action" against workers, such as: ... Disciplining ... falsely accusing the employee of poor performance
dato: documentar acciones disciplinarias de forma objetiva
texto_fiel: No tomes acciones disciplinarias ni otras represalias contra quien denunció un problema de seguridad
razon: El libro no habla de documentar sanciones; enumera la sanción disciplinaria como represalia prohibida. Buscado document/disciplin en todo el libro: no aparece esa práctica.

frase_clave: Workers under 16 do not perform jobs or tasks prohibited by state and federal child labor laws.
razon: Verificar las leyes de trabajo infantil por edad.

frase_clave: Contact NIOSH: 1-800-CDC-INFO or TTY 1-888232-6348, cdcinfo@cdc. gov.
razon: Contacto de NIOSH dado por el libro.

frase_clave: employers request a consultation visit from their local Consultation program and determine the scope of the visit. The visit may focus on a single concern at a facility or it may involve a thorough hazard assessment of an entire facility
texto_fiel: Decide el alcance de la visita: un problema puntual o una evaluación completa de tu local
razon: El libro dice que el empleador determina el alcance; junto al consultor añade quién decide, en la misma dirección.

frase_clave: Doors, passageways and stairways that are neither exits nor access to exits, but could be mistaken for exits, are appropriately marked "NOT AN EXIT,"
Workplace violence incidents are identified in safety and health records, including the OSHA 300 log, first aid records, near miss reports, workers' compensation records, or insurance reports.
razon: Localiza el registro OSHA sin añadir.

frase_clave: Workers are trained at least annually in the proper use of respirators, including putting on and removing them, any limitations on their use, and their maintenance.
All work-related fatalities are reported to OSHA within 8 hours. All work-related in-patient hospitalizations, amputations, and loss of an eye are reported to OSHA within 24 hours.
texto_fiel: Reporta una fatalidad en muy pocas horas y una hospitalizacion, amputacion o perdida de ojo en el plazo algo mayor que fije tu mercado
razon: El libro da un plazo concreto para la fatalidad (8 horas en EE. UU.), no de inmediato; plazo cambiado. Buscado immediate: no se aplica al reporte de fatalidades.

frase_clave: Fire alarm system has been certified, is in proper working condition, and is tested annually.
texto_fiel: Asegura que tu sistema de alarma contra incendios esté certificado, funcione bien y se pruebe una vez al año
razon: El libro fija la prueba anual; la certificación no lleva frecuencia. Buscado certif en todo el libro: no hay certificación anual de alarmas.

frase_clave: Cord-connected, electrically operated tools and equipment are effectively grounded or of the approved double insulated type.
texto_fiel: Asegurar que las herramientas y equipos eléctricos con cable estén conectados a tierra o sean de doble aislamiento aprobado
razon: El libro admite la alternativa del doble aislamiento; el paso solo pide conexión a tierra. Misma dirección, sin datos nuevos.

frase_clave: If you are in a state with an OSHA-approved State Plan, you may be subject to different or additional requirements
If required by state law, all workers under 18 have a valid work permit issued by their school district or another designated agency.
analyze the possible hazards in terms of your workplace, your equipment, your materials, and your workers.
Cord-connected, electrically operated equipment, and flexible cord sets (extension cords) are visually inspected before use for external defects
Automatic sprinkler system water control valves and pressure gages are checked periodically.
Occupational injuries or illnesses, except minor injuries requiring only first aid, are recorded on OSHA Form 300
Young workers are taught about safety and health hazards present on the job ... Young worker training provides key job safety instruction, including safe work practices and equipment
Where exit doors open directly onto a street, alley, or other area where vehicles may be operated, adequate barriers and warnings are provided
Review the OSHA standards to identify those that apply to your business.

Workers who believe an employer has retaliated against them for exercising their safety and health rights should contact their local OSHA office right away. A worker must file a retaliation complaint with OSHA within 30 calendar days
dato: que el empleador ayude a presentar la queja
texto_fiel: Si alguien de tu equipo cree haber sufrido represalias, debe presentar la queja ante la autoridad de tu mercado cuanto antes y dentro del plazo legal
razon: El libro asigna la queja al trabajador; no pone al empleador como responsable de ayudar a presentarla. Buscado help/assist en esa sección: no aparece.

frase_clave: A supplementary record of each recordable occupational injury and illness is prepared for recordable cases on OSHA Form 301
FACE investigation reports and related NIOSH worker safety and health documents can be accessed at the NIOSH FACE webpage.
Section 11(c) of the OSH Act prohibits any person from firing or in any manner retaliating against any worker for exercising rights under the OSH Act.
texto_fiel: Asegura que en tu negocio nadie tome represalias contra quien plantea o denuncia un problema de seguridad
razon: El libro establece la prohibición legal; una política interna la concreta en la misma dirección, sin cifra ni plazo nuevos.

frase_clave: Fuel gas cylinders and oxygen cylinders in storage are separated by a distance of at least 20 feet, or by a non-combustible barrier at least 5 feet (1. 5m) high, having a fire-resistance rating of at least 30 minutes.
razon: Mismas cifras; abrevia la barrera (omite no combustible y 30 minutos) sin cambiar valores.

frase_clave: Before workers first use, or are fit-tested for, a respirator, they receive a medical evaluation
consultants ... work with employers to identify safety and health hazards in workplaces and how to fix them.
razon: Aplicar lo que recomienda el consultor.

frase_clave: PIT operator performance is evaluated at least once every three years
The number of exits from each floor or level, and the number of exits from the building itself, are appropriate for the occupant load.

Engineering controls (e. g. , access to exits, physical barriers, and security technology, such as panic buttons/alarm systems) and administrative controls (e. g. , ... protocols for calling security and/or the police)
razon: Literal parafraseado; el sistema de acompañamiento está en L1707.

frase_clave: No revolving, sliding, or overhead doors serve as required exit doors.
Cylinders are regularly examined for obvious signs of defects, deep rusting, and leakage.
texto_fiel: Revisar con regularidad los cilindros en busca de óxido profundo, defectos y fugas
razon: El libro dice regularly sin frecuencia. Buscado quarter/three months/trimest en todo el libro: no aparece.

frase_clave: Red is used to identify the acetylene (and other fuel-gas) hose, green is used for the oxygen hose, and black is used for inert gas and air hoses.
Are any of these job-related risk factors for heat exposure present in your workplace?
Workers are properly trained, and certified by the employer ... and only trained workers operate the PIT.
The plan considers all potential natural or man-made emergencies ... all potential internal sources of emergencies
Toeboards are installed around the edges of permanent floor holes where persons may pass below the hole.
texto_fiel: Colocar rodapiés en los bordes de las aberturas permanentes cuando pueda pasar gente por debajo
razon: El libro condiciona el rodapié a que pasen personas por debajo de la abertura (protege de objetos que caen, L1441); el paso cambia la condición a donde transite personal.

frase_clave: especially over the first several weeks on the job
Accurate records of workplace violence incidents are maintained and analyzed to determine what corrective actions are needed.
